no_git_installed: git executable not detected: file history relies on git snapshots. Install git and add it to PATH to enable this option.
no_git_repo: The project directory is not a git repository: file history relies on git snapshots. Run git init in the project directory to enable this option.
desc_default_off: Off by default: no git commit is made in the project repository unless you explicitly enable it here.
desc_on: When enabled, at each turn boundary (turn start and LLM completion) the project directory is checked for uncommitted changes; if any, a git add -A followed by a snapshot commit is made (message includes session and changed file count). Snapshots are plain git commits in the project directory, viewable/restorable with git.
desc_off: When disabled, no snapshot commit is made at turn boundaries; git commits already created are kept as-is (still viewable with git).
enable_confirm: Enabling will create git commits/snapshots in the project repository (git add -A + commit), which has side effects on your repository. Enable anyway?
